name: Land Locked - Lucius Log
source:
Whoever said you can’t have your cake and eat it too was sorely mistaken. Because not only has Lucius been eating all the cakes he wants, he’s absolutely loving life. With his overbearing family long out of his hair, he’s free to chase whatever calls to him, be it gluttonous indulgence of the finest food, shameless displays of his beautifully bouncy body, or supplying his talents to unique business ventures.

Tonight, it looks like he’ll get to do all three.

A long-time friend and encourager has called him over to discuss a new project of his, the S.S. Skayle, a cruise liner designed for only the biggest of clientele. And given Sterling's appetite for all things big in life, Lucius is certain anyone who comes aboard won’t be leaving without a few more rolls and folds. Boreas, Sterling's assistant and newest pet-project, is a prime example of the unicorns charms. And given how familiar the stubbornly repressed wolf is to a past version of himself, Lucius can’t help but want to tip the scales just a little bit further…
